message:
Blog slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters, so "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes all 3 tests, including `test/blog-slug.test.js`.

The cause is in the vendored slugify, which strips every non-ASCII letter. I left `vendor/` alone, as you asked. Instead, `postSlug` in `src/blog/slug.js` now strips the accents from the title before passing it to slugify.

`src/shop/product-url.js` also uses slugify. I didn't change it, so product URLs still drop accented letters unless you want the same fix there.
